devices.name: Core2
blockers: physical cache/PSRAM timing equivalence remains NOT RUN
bit-exact ESP32 BT baseband/controller remains NOT RUN
more than one hundred twenty reconnect cycles and multi-hour coexistence/soak remain NOT RUN

validation.detail: Official UIFlow2 v2.5.3 runs the 320x240 display/touch, AXP2101, INA3221, MPU6886, PCF8563, NS4168 speaker, SPM1423 microphone, OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP, public DNS/HTTP and stock-firmware external BLE GATT in one m5core2 guest. Deterministic tcg,thread=single plus icount passed ten independent first attempts without retry. The canonical Device Service profile core2-native-hci passes the HCI-4 functional baseline in five independent leases with gdb_bridge=false. Patch 0005 restores caller-saved Xtensa sregs around nested guest calls and restricts HLI allocator/callback injection to halted/idle vCPU state; two independent 5x10s batches pass 10/10, three 60s holds pass 3/3, two 120s holds pass 2/2 and two active-BLE 600s holds pass 2/2 with hli-errors=0 and empty HLI/meta/TX queues. Three independent leases pass same-guest scan/connect/NUS GATT/disconnect reconnect gates at 20, 30, 60 and 120 cycles per lease. The 120-cycle run balances HLI 3377/3377, delivers 2297 events and 1080 ACLs, with zero HLI/meta/TX queue errors, no panic or dropped packets, and connection/L2CAP/GATT pools back at 3/9/3. The accepted reconnect range is 1-120 and 121 is rejected. The 600-second active-BLE holds keep the peer connected with HLI 45/45 and zero queue or link errors. The earlier ten-cycle attempt exposed a Device Service 30-second wait cap, which now uses the session ready timeout and has a regression test. The historical stale-ACK failure was traced to the external Bumble compatibility layer replying to no-response HCI command 0x0c35. The legacy core2-native-vhci profile remains diagnostic because its repeated-lease result is 1/2. More than one hundred twenty reconnect cycles, two-hour soak, physical cache/PSRAM equivalence, coexistence and a bit-exact Espressif BT baseband/controller remain open.

validation.detail: UIFlow2 P4 firmware boots through esp-emu 0.50.0 with the C6 ESP-Hosted bridge, renders a 1280x720 landscape frame from the real M5GFX framebuffer, and redraws after touch. P4 I2C scans Tab5 devices; INA226 preload reaches Power as 8000mV/1248mA/87%, direct machine.I2C write/read reaches RX8130 registers, PI4IOE output writeback passes, and CHG_STAT=0x00/0x40 reaches Power.isCharging() as charging/discharging. UART1 RS-485 half-duplex TX/RX passes against a host peer on G20/G21 with direction G34. RTC progression, dynamic BMI270/time/I2C injection, IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and the remaining native P4 data planes remain partial.
